note: esmini ships no FMI-LS-REF reference result. What it does ship is the
vendor's own expected trajectory for this scenario: exact positions and
speeds asserted by its smoke test, produced with --headless and
The smoke test runs the scenario once per ALKS safety model and merges
the four recordings with the replayer, which offsets object ids by 100
per merged file. The id block is therefore the merge order of the
recording files, not the order of the model list in the test. Which
block belongs to which model was determined here by running all four
models through SE_InitWithString and comparing: 0/1 is FSM, 100/101 is
RSS, 300/301 is Regulation. The scenario file as distributed declares
model=Regulation with cruise=true, so the 300/301 rows are its
expectation and those are the rows transcribed below.
Values are quoted to the three decimals the vendor's csv carries.
